entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Jud 10:1-5 . Tola Judges Israel in Shamir.

entries.heading: 3. Jair, a Gileadite
entries.text: 3. Jair, a Gileadite --This judge was a different person from the conqueror of that northeastern territory, and founder of Havoth-jair, or "Jair's villages" ( Nu 32:41; De 3:14; Jos 13:3; 1Ch 2:22 ).

entries.heading: 4. he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts
entries.text: 4. he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts --This is a characteristic trait of Eastern manners in those early times; and the grant of a village to each of his thirty sons was a striking proof of his extensive possessions. His having thirty sons is no conclusive evidence that he had more than one wife, much less that he had more than one at a time. There are instances, in this country, of men having as many children by two successive wives.

entries.heading: Verse 6
entries.text: Jud 10:6-9 . Israel Oppressed by the Philistines and Ammonites.

entries.heading: 7. Philistines, and . . . the children of Ammon
entries.text: 7. Philistines, and . . . the children of Ammon --The predatory incursions of these two hostile neighbors were made naturally on the parts of the land respectively contiguous to them. But the Ammonites, animated with the spirit of conquest, carried their arms across the Jordan; so that the central and southern provinces of Canaan were extensively desolated.

entries.heading: 11. the Lord said . . . Did I not deliver you from the Egyptians
entries.text: 11. the Lord said . . . Did I not deliver you from the Egyptians --The circumstances recorded in this and the following verses were not probably made through the high priest, whose duty it was to interpret the will of God.

entries.heading: Verse 16
entries.text: Jud 10:16-18 . They Repent; God Pities Them.

entries.heading: 17, 18. the children of Ammon were gathered together
entries.text: 17, 18. the children of Ammon were gathered together --From carrying on guerrilla warfare, the Ammonites proceeded to a continued campaign. Their settled aim was to wrest the whole of the trans-jordanic territory from its actual occupiers. In this great crisis, a general meeting of the Israelitish tribes was held at Mizpeh. This Mizpeh was in eastern Manasseh ( Jos 11:3 ).
